# Alphabyte AI

> Alphabyte AI is a Claude-native consulting firm that designs and delivers working AI for mid-market organizations. Four service tracks. Real deployments. No junior bench. Operating across North America since 2016.

Alphabyte is the AI and data consulting practice of Alphabyte Solutions Inc. Claude is the entire practice -- not a competency added to a service menu. The flagship offering is Citizen Developer Enablement: governed Claude environments that turn every employee into an AI developer.

## Services

- [Citizen Development](https://alphabyte.ai/services/citizen-development/): Governed Claude environment, SDLC tooling, and guardrails deployed against existing workflows. Every employee becomes an AI developer. 3-12 weeks.
- [Executive Enablement](https://alphabyte.ai/services/executive-enablement/): Custom Claude environment built from operational data -- knowledgebases, skills, prompt toolkit. Leadership sees measurable time savings in the first sprint. 2-4 weeks.
- [Discovery](https://alphabyte.ai/services/discovery/): Four-week AI strategy engagement. Stakeholder workshops, use case prioritization, gap analysis, and an executable roadmap. 3-5 weeks.
- [Data Readiness](https://alphabyte.ai/services/data-readiness/): Data quality audit, governance assessment, AI readiness scorecard, and remediation pathway for regulated industries. 4-8 weeks.
- [Infrastructure](https://alphabyte.ai/services/infrastructure/): Custom MCP servers, autonomous agents, on-premise LLMs, and fine-tuned models. Where Claude connects to live operational systems. 4-36 weeks.

## Tools

- [Claude](https://alphabyte.ai/tools/claude/): The intelligence layer for all engagements. Alphabyte is Anthropic-certified and configures Claude across Teams, Enterprise, and API tiers.
- [MCP](https://alphabyte.ai/tools/mcp/): Model Context Protocol servers for secure, governed connectivity between Claude and internal systems.
- [Custom AI Agents](https://alphabyte.ai/tools/custom-ai-agents/): Autonomous task execution built on Claude, deployed with governance and observability.
- [On-Premise LLM](https://alphabyte.ai/tools/on-premise-llm/): Self-hosted models for organizations where data cannot leave the network.

## Case Studies

- [Construction Compliance Agent](https://alphabyte.ai/our-work/fire-protection-compliance/): Custom MCP server and knowledge graph navigating regulatory code with citation-grade accuracy for a multi-entity North American construction firm.
- [Executive Productivity Suite](https://alphabyte.ai/our-work/circular-economy-platform/): Custom Claude plugin giving leadership a single command surface across GSuite, Slack, Power BI, and Fireflies for a major global supplier.
- [Media Buy Analytics Agent](https://alphabyte.ai/our-work/media-buy-analytics/): Custom Power BI MCP server connecting Claude to Microsoft Fabric semantic models for self-service media spend analytics for a DTC e-commerce brand.
- [Community Housing AI Enablement](https://alphabyte.ai/our-work/community-housing-organisation/): Seven-recommendation roadmap from data governance to five purpose-built Claude agents for a Canadian public sector housing organization.
